title: Human review of model flags
description: A teammate's decision on each C8 flag raised by the local model for one finding. Lives in stages/05_auditar/output/reviews/F-XXX.json. auditar.py creates it with every flag 'pending'; a person edits it; the next run honors it. Only model answers (Q3-Q7) can be dismissed; code checks cannot.

finding_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the finding file that was reviewed. If the finding changes, this review stops applying.

model_reason.description: What the model said (copied by auditar.py, for context)

decision.description: dismiss = false alarm, ignore it; confirm = real problem, keep failing C8; pending = not reviewed yet
